title: Classification Criteria
text: Whittaker's system uses three main criteria: 1) Cell type (prokaryotic or eukaryotic), 2) Number of cells (unicellular or multicellular), 3) Mode of nutrition (autotrophic or heterotrophic, and how they obtain food).

title: The Five Groups
text: Start with the simplest: Monera (bacteria - prokaryotes). Then eukaryotes: Protista (mostly unicellular), and three multicellular kingdoms - Fungi (absorb nutrients), Plantae (make food by photosynthesis), Animalia (ingest food).
